content:
You can monitor Auto-Tune statistics in Amazon CloudWatch. For a full list of metrics, see the
section called “Auto-Tune metrics”.
OpenSearch Service sends Auto-Tune events to Amazon EventBridge. You can use EventBridge to
conﬁgure rules that send an email or perform a speciﬁc action when an event is received. To see
the format of each Auto-Tune event sent to EventBridge, see the section called “Auto-Tune events”.
